Maya K: Quick scrub — postmortem for INC-514. Need reconfirmed owners + due dates for the action items before Friday. I’ll paste the current list below; please ack and add ETA. cc @Diego @Priya @Sam

```
1) Update canary rollback playbook — assigned: Diego — due: 2025-03-12
2) Add KV cache metrics to perf dashboard — assigned: Priya — due: 2025-03-14
3) Re-run regression prompts to verify quality delta — assigned: Sam — due: 2025-03-13
4) Customer-facing incident note draft — assigned: Maya — due: 2025-03-11
5) Add RBAC audit for deployment pipeline — unassigned — due: 2025-03-18
```

Diego R: Ack. I can take #1. Can we move the due to 2025-03-13 so I can pair with eng-infra during their maintenance window? I’ll need eng-infra to enable a canary harness flag. @eng-infra

Priya S: Ack for #2. ETA 2025-03-14. Small ask — metrics team needs to expose `kv.hit_rate` and `kv.latency_p95` by EOD for me to finish the panels. @Sam can you follow up with metrics?

Sam H: Ack for #3. I need the eval shards from QA to re-run the regression set. If I get shards today I can finish by 2025-03-12, otherwise it’s 2025-03-15. @Maya can you loop QA?

Maya K: Taking #4, draft will be ready by 2025-03-11 AM PT. Looping QA now for shards.

Diego R: For #5 (RBAC audit) — I can help with the pipeline bits but security should own the audit. @eng-security who can drive?

ops-bot: Reminder: RCA tracker updated: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-514 — please update "owner" and "due_date" fields if you claim an item.

Priya S: :thumbsup: I’ll prod metrics and post updates here if they push the schema change.

Sam H: I added a short checklist in the PR for the regression run: https://git.redwood/repo/1234 — pinged QA for shards.

Maya K: Action: everyone update tracker before EOD so I can consolidate for leadership. If you can’t meet the ETA, post a new date + short reason in the tracker.

Diego R: Will update tracker and add infra dependency notes (canary flag + window).

Priya S: Updated owner+ETA for #2 in the tracker.

Sam H: Updated #3 to 2025-03-15 in the tracker — QA shipped shards late.

Maya K: Thanks — I’ll collate and send a short readout. Closing this thread in 24h unless objections. :pray:
